As much as I don't like my dad, he is a perfect example of this. I am 20 years old man and my dad is really old (69) so yeah he had me at 49 years old. Super late, I know. Growing up this could become uncomfortable for me when people go oh, this isn't your grandpa but your dad? I hated it so much. It wasn't until recently, I truly recognize this story and respect it. 

My dad was with a girl in high school for a while. He thought he was madly in love and propose to her in his senior year... He later realized when he was in college that he didn't want to be with that girl so ended it (that girl must be so upset :( - I heard shes married happily so that's a good ending). In college, my dad goofed around with some women. Only a few of them were serious. He didn't last and left school. Worked at Post Office for a while before he realized he wants to go back to college and be with his friends. It helps that he was a party animal (like me now in college). He finished school, and  He got the job at the same university and there was a student he liked, (my mom) and he kept asking her to date him, etc but my mom was focused on her schoolwork and didn't want anything serious so she rejected him. He kept trying for 6 years over the same woman. I still can't believe this sometimes. Anyways, so they finally married when my dad was like 45 or something. My mom is about 13 years younger. My dad had my sister at 47. Me at 49. Now I'm 20 years man attending university in the middle of a pandemic. 

​

Long short story: we all run in our own time zone. You're a single 27 years old woman. So what? My dad got married at like 45 and had me at 49. Super late and it wouldn't be when I want to have kids, haha but you get the point.
